messages:
Nina (People Ops): Mid-cycle check: we've had a spike in reviewer accessibility issues (travel, interviews, on-call). Two asks: 1) nominate deputy reviewers if you need a delegated sign-off; 2) if you expect >2 late evidence uploads, flag them now so we can extend the team deadline by 24h.
Gabe (ENG Manager): Thanks. Quick q: what's the difference between a deputy and a backup in practice?
Nina (People Ops): Good question. Backup = alternate who can annotate and finalize only if the original reviewer is unreachable (short swap). Deputy = pre-authorized person who can finalize in place of the reviewer according to the delegation scope you set. Deputies will appear in the audit CSV.
Lily (HRBP): Add: deputies with finalize rights must be at manager level or have explicit written delegation from the manager. That keeps auditability for comp decisions.
Omar (SRE): If a deputy finalizes and changes a rating by more than one band, does that trigger a calibration exception?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 94 any change >1 band triggers an exception. Deputies should add `cal-exception: true` + 1-line justification when that happens. We'll fast-track those.
Priya (Recruiting): I can move interviews to help reviewers. If you post time ranges and Lattice handles here I'll shift candidate slots.
Gabe (ENG Manager): I'll nominate a deputy for Team Halley: Simone (@simone-eng). Scope `finalize-if-absent` because Simone travels but can sign. Where do we paste the formal delegation?
Nina (People Ops): Paste this verbatim as a comment in the review: ```Deputy: Simone (@simone-eng)
Scope: finalize-if-absent
Reason: travel with limited access
Delegation-notes: finalize only if reviewer inaccessible >24h``` We'll pull those comments for the audit CSV.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Deputy nominations due" in 6 hours. :bell:
Lily (HRBP): Also reminder: deputies who finalize should add a 1-line note on comp-time eligibility if they did >2 extra reviews. Use `comp-time-eligible: X hours`. HR will batch-approve.
Omar (SRE): One reviewer on my team is mid-security-clearance and cannot access some documents. Can we mark reviews `restricted` and provide deputies with redacted evidence packs?
Nina (People Ops): Yes. Tag `restricted: clearance` and give deputies a redacted doc. Deputies without clearance must prefix their note with `redacted-review` so calibrators know context is limited.
Gabe (ENG Manager): Question re: late evidence. If a manager uploads evidence after the finalization but before calibration, does that reopen the packet?
Nina (People Ops): We don't reopen final ratings for minor evidence additions. If the new evidence materially affects the rating (manager believes so), mark `reopen-request: yes` with a 1-line rationale and we'll triage. Otherwise append to the manager evidence folder and note `post-final-evidence`.
Priya (Recruiting): Posting candidate conflict ranges: Mon 13:00-15:00 PT & Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. If you need those moved DM me Lattice handles.
Gabe (ENG Manager): Adding deputy now. Also flagging two late evidence items for one IC 94 will we get a 24h extension?
Nina (People Ops): If it's <=2 late evidence items across the team we'll grant a 24h team extension; if >2, tag `bulk-late-evidence` here and we'll assess on a case-by-case. For now consider your team approved for +24h.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: "Confirm deputy + late evidence flags" scheduled in 18 hours. :bell:
Lily (HRBP): One compliance note: redact any PII from uploaded logs or customer screenshots before sharing outside the region. There's a `redaction-checklist.md` in the shared folder. If unsure, DM legal.
Omar (SRE): I'll nominate my deputy and request redacted access for them. Also: on-call extension policy still applies if an incident >2hrs occurs 94 those reviewers get +24h automatically but deputies may be needed for audit deadlines.
Priya (Recruiting): I've moved two interviews for Simone's team to free up her afternoon on Tues. DM me if you need more.
Gabe (ENG Manager): Done. Deputy added and delegation comment pasted. Thanks.
Nina (People Ops): Perfect. If anyone needs temp Lattice permission for deputies, DM me `grant-temp <lattice-handle> <review-id>` and we'll do a 2-hour window. After the bot reminder, if anything changes, DM and cc people-ops@redwood.com. Thanks everyone! :clap:
